Una función lógica de <i>n</i> variables: A logic function of n variables has 2n input combinations. They are numbered in binary: row 5 of three variables is 101, that is, A = 1, B = 0, C = 1. The truth table says what the output is in each row.
Un <b>minitérmino</b> es el producto (AN: A minterm is the product (AND) of all the variables, with a bar on those that are 0 in that row: it is 1 only in its row. The function is the sum (OR) of the minterms of the rows where it is 1: Σm, the first canonical form. A maxterm is the sum (OR) of all the variables, with a bar on those that are 1: it is 0 only in its row. The function is the product (AND) of the maxterms of the rows where it is 0: ΠM, the second canonical form.
Dos minitérminos que se diferencian en u: Two minterms that differ in a single variable are merged (A·B + A·B′ = A). This is what a Karnaugh map does by grouping adjacent ones, and what the Quine-McCluskey method automates. The X's (don't-cares) are combinations that never occur or do not matter: they are used as 1 if they help to group. For the product of sums, the zeros are grouped and the result is complemented.
AND vale 1 si todas sus entradas valen 1: AND is 1 if all its inputs are 1; OR, if any is 1; NOT inverts; NAND, NOR and XNOR are the negations of AND, OR and XOR; XOR is 1 if the number of inputs at 1 is odd. NAND and NOR are universal: any function can be built with just one of them.

NAND y NOR son puertas universales: con: NAND and NOR are universal gates: two layers of NAND make any sum of products and two of NOR any product of sums (De Morgan). A static hazard appears when two neighboring cells with 1 are covered by different groups on the map: when the input changes, a glitch to 0 may appear; it is avoided by adding the consensus term. A flip-flop stores one bit: D copies its input, T inverts it if it is 1, JK combines both and SR does not allow S = R = 1. For a counter, you write which inputs each flip-flop needs at each step (excitation table) and simplify them with Karnaugh, with the unused states as don't-cares.
